reviews.title: Good for newbies
reviews.text: I just started training like, really from zero, never been sporty person tbh. Didn’t wanna jump into gym and look lost, so I tried HitFit as a home workout first. It’s simple, teh videos are simple and easy to follow, they explain stuff without overdoing it, so I don’t feel stupid trying to keep up. I mostly use it as a workout planner so I don’t think too much, just open app and go! Still early days but I feel more confident already. I also noticed there are new Tai Chi walking workouts available, they’re really interesting and actually work well for improving balance. Overall, it’s motivating, approachable, and not scary at all. I can recommend this app

reviews.title: Disappointed. Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: App doesn’t sync across devices. I have it both on my phone and iPad and when i use iPad the information doesn’t sync over to my phone so i loose my progress. Also not able to link to my apple fitness which is where i monitor all fitness routines whether I’m using this app or something else (ie yoga or Pilates). It also doesn’t tell me calories burned for each workout. It gives a summary of ALL workout and not for each so if i wanted to go back and view a particular workout, the information is not there. I’m even disappointed in customer service… as i sent an inquiry about the problems to see if it can be resolved and no one can contacted me. So don’t waste your money. I wish i had known these things before i bought the app. It’s extremely inconvenient to keep track of your overall workout progress.

reviews.title: Doesn’t create a workout plan
reviews.text: This app is basically just a large directory of workouts. It does not create a custom workout plan, nor does it tell you exactly how much you should work out in and what areas of your body you should focus on. If I download and pay for an app, I want you to do the work for me. Only want to do what you tell me I should do to get the body I want. I cannot recommend this.
